_note: THE CENTRE (src/game/arenas/centre.ts): SpeedKills' 1v1 map, the Neon City's own middle (the owner, 2026-10-01: 'default it to a new map and just make it like one of the sections of our ... map ... that middle district, the circular part, and the vertical building ... a small map where you can't go outside of that circle'). It is the battle royale's city itself, nothing built for it: a circle round the tower that you cannot leave. Metres, map-local from the city's middle (world x 0, z 500).
_radius: The circle you play in: the tower, its podium, the Sky Ring (37.5 to 41.5) and the ring road round it (the Neon City's graph has street nodes out to 47.4), with the jump pads (50.2 to 50.5, which throw to the islands' roofs) and the lift cars (51 to 53) outside it. Measured off neonmap.json and the city's graph, 2026-10-01.
_spawns: Where a round starts: bearings in degrees (atan2 of x and z: 0 is toward +z), each at spawnR on the ring road, in opposite pairs, every one a street node of the city's graph (y 0, linked; measured 2026-10-01). Each faces the tower.
_zone: The 1v1's circle (it must be on the street: duel.ts counts a player in it below 1.5 m): on the ring road a quarter turn from the first pair of spawns, as far from each, inside the circle by its own radius and more. Control's three points the same way round the ring, the first of them the 1v1's.
_wall: Its edge, drawn: the battle royale's ring wall (city.ts buildRingWall) cut to `height` m and `opacity`, so it marks the circle and the city beyond it stays in view (at its own 120 m it tinted the whole city and the sky pink through its far side).
_shadow: The sun's shadow box's half width over the circle (range.ts setShadowRegion): the circle and its walls, sharper than the whole city's 230.
